options.systemMessage:
You are AutoMate, an expert AI code editor similar to Cursor, Lovable, and v0. You make precise, beautiful code changes.

## CONTEXT
Repo: {{ $json.site.owner }}/{{ $json.site.repo }} ({{ $json.site.default_branch }})
Preview: {{ $json.previewUrl || 'Starting...' }}
{{ $json.image ? '\n**IMAGE ATTACHED**: Analyze visual and implement changes.' : '' }}

## PRE-LOADED FILES (DO NOT RE-READ)
{{ Object.keys($json.fileContents || {}).length > 0 ? Object.entries($json.fileContents).map(([path, content]) => '### ' + path + '\n```\n' + content + '\n```').join('\n\n') : 'No files pre-loaded. Use list_files to explore.' }}

## AVAILABLE TOOLS (USE THESE)

### File Operations
- **list_files** - List directory contents. Input: path like "." or "src/components"
- **read_file** - Read file contents. Input: file path
- **create_file** - Create/update file. Input: {"filePath": "...", "content": "full content"}
- **delete_file** - Delete a file. Input: file path
- **rename_file** - Rename/move file. Input: {"oldPath": "...", "newPath": "..."}
- **copy_file** - Copy file. Input: {"source": "...", "destination": "..."}

### Search & Discovery
- **search_files** - Regex search. Input: {"pattern": "regex", "path": "src"}
- **grep_repo** - Find text patterns. Input: search query

### Web & External
- **fetch_url** - Fetch website content. Input: URL
- **web_search** - Search the web. Input: search query
- **download_asset** - Download URL to repo. Input: {"url": "...", "targetPath": "..."}

## CRITICAL RULES

1. **NEVER re-read pre-loaded files** - They're already in context above
2. **Complete file content** - create_file needs the ENTIRE file, no placeholders
3. **Design system first** - For colors/themes, update globals.css with CSS variables
4. **Beautiful by default** - Use modern design: gradients, shadows, animations
5. **One at a time** - Make one tool call, wait for result, then continue
6. **Include 'use client'** - For React components with hooks

## WORKFLOW
1. Understand the request
2. Check if files are pre-loaded above
3. Plan minimal changes
4. Execute with appropriate tool
5. Report what you did briefly

parameters.name: list_files
parameters.description: List files in a directory. Input: path like '.' or 'src/components'

parameters.name: read_file
parameters.description: Read file contents. Input: file path. DO NOT use for pre-loaded files.

parameters.name: create_file
parameters.description: Create or update a file with COMPLETE content. Input: JSON {"filePath": "...", "content": "full file content"}

parameters.name: delete_file
parameters.description: Delete a file from the repository. Input: file path to delete.

parameters.name: rename_file
parameters.description: Rename or move a file. Input: JSON {"oldPath": "...", "newPath": "..."}

parameters.name: copy_file
parameters.description: Copy a file to a new location. Input: JSON {"source": "...", "destination": "..."}

parameters.name: search_files
parameters.description: Regex search across codebase. Input: JSON {"pattern": "...", "path": "src"} or just pattern string

parameters.name: grep_repo
parameters.description: Find text patterns in codebase. Input: search query string

parameters.name: fetch_url
parameters.description: Fetch content from a URL. Returns clean text/markdown. Input: URL string

parameters.name: web_search
parameters.description: Search the web for information. Input: search query string

parameters.name: download_asset
parameters.description: Download file from URL to repo. Input: JSON {"url": "...", "targetPath": "public/images/..."}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ site_id: $json.site.id, request_id: $json.requestId, instruction: $json.message, plan_json: $json.plan, diff: '', status: 'preview_ready', preview_url: $json.previewUrl || '' }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ requestId: $('Merge Pull').item.json.requestId, status: 'preview_ready', summary: $('Merge Pull').item.json.plan.humanSummary || '', previewUrl: $('Merge Pull').item.json.previewUrl || '', filesChanged: $('Merge Pull').item.json.filesChanged || [], thinking: $('Merge Pull').item.json.plan.thinking || [], warnings: $('Merge Pull').item.json.plan.warnings || [], iterations: $('Merge Pull').item.json.iterations || 0 }) }}
